How to read ✕

State

✓ActiveMonitored, with every input it is expected to have. !DegradedMonitored, but an expected input is missing: a VP tag or peer links. Nearly every loop has one, so it is a filter, not a row badge. ○Not monitoredRegistered without monitoring: no results are produced. ⊘RetiredThe loop stopped being monitored. Its history stays, and Restore brings it back.

VP

MappedA valve-position tag is mapped. Not mappedA valve position is expected, and no tag is mapped: a valve cause stops at suspected (G14). No VPThe loop has no valve position: not installed, or not applicable (a drive or a direct action).

Readiness

A loop is only as good as its signal mappingsThe readiness lists exactly what is missing; Edit configuration shows it again after saving. VP expected, not mappedMap the VP tag so non-following evidence can confirm a valve fault (G14). Peer links expected, missingInteraction analysis unavailable (G13) until peers are configured. Plant facts, nothing to fix1 without a valve (valve diagnosis does not apply).

Optional inputs

Valve position

Without a valve-position (VP) signal, G14 cannot confirm a final-element fault: such a verdict stops at suspected. Oscillation and effort verdicts are unaffected.
